x86_64.notes: Full shinchiro winbuild (filters enabled), pinned to the retained weekly SourceForge archive. Same mpv revision dd5d17d328 as the retired 20260808 GitHub build. Not the media_kit slim audio build.

universal.notes: Prefer audio-full over media_kit's audio-default. fetch_full_libmpv.sh lifts the versioned wrapper so xcframeworks sit at macos/universal/*.xcframework. This project has never published past mpv 0.36.0, so client API 2.1 is the ceiling on macOS and therefore the version include/mpv is pinned to — see README.

linux.notes: Prefer distro full libmpv (filters present). Optional: place libmpv.so* under third_party/libmpv/linux/x86_64 for bundling.
